[Passive - Primal Pact]
Masha has 3 HP bars and dies only when the last one is depleted. Masha gains Feral when dealing damage to heroes or creeps. Feral converts to HP when out of combat. Masha leaves a Wound on the enemy when dealing skill damage to them. Attacking again with a Basic Attack from the direction of the Wound will break it, putting Masha into the Feral state. While in the Feral state, her next 3 Basic Attacks become wide-range claw strikes, and she gains massive Resilience, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed.

[Aulus] (↑)
Aulus takes too long to ramp up, struggles to finish off enemies, and lacks survivability in extended fights. We're addressing these issues by accelerating his ramp-up, condensing his damage into a shorter window, and improving his HP Regen.

[Argus] (↑)
Based on your feedback, we've decided to make another round of balance adjustments and gameplay improvements to Argus.
Argus can now trigger Demonic Slash more often and stun enemies with Skill 2. The increased Ultimate damage helps him counterattack or secure kills.

[Aldous] (↑)
Exp Lane heroes need to serve as a primary force in early-game skirmishes. Aldous's reliance on Skill 1 stacks for damage forced him to farm passively in the early game, leaving him completely out of sync with the team's pace. To boost his early-game combat capability and income while keeping his core playstyle intact, we've made the following adjustments.

[Lukas] (↑)
Lukas was slightly weak in the Exp Lane but too strong as a jungler. To make him stronger in the Exp Lane while preserving his jungler playstyle, we've made some adjustments to him.

[Classic Zilong] (↓)
We've noticed that Classic Zilong was a bit too strong, even proving hard to handle in Classic mode. As a result, we've reduced his damage and how often he gains Control Immunity.
That said. Even after these adjustments, Classic Zilong can still pick off enemy heroes amid the chaos of battle.

[Classic Akai] (↑)
We've slightly increased Classic Akai's damage and adjusted his Ultimate's knockback frequency to match that of the current Akai.

[Odette] (~)
To make Odette feel more like a graceful dancer, she can now move freely at a slightly reduced speed while casting her Ultimate.

[Sun] (~)
We've noticed that roaming Sun takes too many resources away from his teammates, negatively affecting their experience. We've therefore made targeted adjustments to rein in his roaming build while minimizing the impact on his performance in other lanes.

[Marcel] (~)
Improved Marcel's skill synergy with other heroes, allowing him to work better with a wider range of heroes. As a balance adjustment, we've slightly reduced his early-game damage and skill cast frequency. Marcel can now interrupt skills that require selecting a target location before dealing damage (e.g., Eudora's Ultimate and Vexana's Skill 2).

[Kalea] (↑)
Kalea's damage and survivability as a Fighter-Support have both fallen short this patch, making her one of the weakest supports right now. To address this, we've decided to give her a comprehensive buff so she can truly perform as a Fighter-Support.

[Kadita] (~)
Increased Kadita's Movement Speed when roaming to the side lane in the early-to-mid game.

[Hylos] (~)
Hylos's previous passive effects were underwhelming, so we've adjusted them to make his growth attributes more consistent.

[Cici] (↑)
Slightly increased the hero's early-to-mid-game damage against high-HP units, the speed of killing the EXP Crab in the early game, and sustainability in team fights.

[Melissa] (↓)
Melissa's Skill 1 provided too much Attack Speed for too long, while Muddles summoned by Skill 2 dealt excessive Basic Attack damage. We've reduced Skill 1's Attack Speed bonus and duration, as well as Muddles' damage transfer ratio and the percentage of Attack Effects inherited.

[Miya] (↓)
Miya's team fight damage and farming speed in the current patch exceeded expectations. We've fixed an issue where Moonlight Shadow's Split Arrow dealt abnormal damage and incorrectly triggered Attack Effects, and slightly reduced Miya's damage to single targets.

[Hanabi](↓)
Hanabi dealt excessive damage to a single target through consecutive Petal Blade bounces in small-scale team fights. To preserve her single-target poke during the laning phase, we haven't changed her base bounce damage. Instead, we've added a bounce damage falloff: when a Basic Attack or skill bounces repeatedly hits the same target, subsequent bounces deal less damage, limiting her sustained output against a single target within a short time.

[Yi Sun-shin] (↓)
Yi Sun-shin's overall mobility was too high, so we've increased Skill 1's cooldown to limit his dash frequency.

[Alpha] (↑)
Alpha's early-game laning was relatively weak, so we've adjusted his Passive to scale with Total Physical Attack, improving his early- to mid-game performance. We've also optimized Skill 2's Regen mechanics by increasing its base HP recovered per hit and reducing the additional HP recovered per hit, improving its sustain when hitting a single target.

[Kagura] (↑)
Improved the feel of controlling the Seimei Umbrella when Kagura repositions in battle.

[Edith] (↓)
Reverted skill values to match those outside the Mythical Honor Battlefield.

[Karina] (↑)
We aim to increase Karina's Skill 1 usage frequency and improve the effectiveness of her Enhanced Basic Attack.

[Paquito] (↓)
To prevent Paquito from snowballing too quickly and zoning enemies out of lane, we've slightly reduced his early-to-mid-game burst damage.

[Kaja] (↑)
Slightly increased Kaja's HP Regen.
[Tigreal] (↑)

[Revealing Wisps]
Pickable Vision Wisps are available across the map. Upon picking one up, the wisp circles around the hero for several seconds. If there are hidden enemy heroes within a large range, the wisp will move to their location and reveal them for several seconds.

[Healing Turtle]
Defeating the Turtle no longer grants a shield. Instead, an allied Turtle will spawn on the enemy's strongest lane to help push it. Allied heroes near the allied Turtle will recover HP rapidly and gain Turtle companions to help push turrets.

[Golden Turret]
Greatly increased the Gold shared to the entire team when any Turret is destroyed. Inner Turret and Base Turret HP are also increased.
Adjusted Turret Interactions for Enhanced Basic Attacks

[Hero Enhanced Basic Attacks]
All heroes' Enhanced Basic Attacks triggered by their own skills can now hit Turrets and apply their HP Regen effects.
Any exceptions will be clearly noted in the corresponding skill description.
Enhanced Basic Attacks from Sun, Argus, Gusion, Thamuz, Dyrroth, and Masha can now trigger HP Regen effects when attacking Turrets.

[Other Enhanced Basic Attacks]
Enhanced Basic Attack effects from Emblems, Battle Spells, and Equipment cannot trigger when attacking Turrets.

[Quantum Charge]
Cannot trigger when attacking Turrets.
When using Inspire to attack Turrets, the Attack Speed boost and defense-ignoring effect still apply, but the HP Regen effect will not trigger.
Control Settings Update
We are now factoring in the attacker's Penetration along with the target's Defense and HP to prioritize locking onto the target that is actually the easiest to kill, rather than just the one with the lowest HP.
As a result, in the Targeting Priority options, "Lowest HP" has been optimized to "Lowest Effective HP".
Special Note: Since a large portion of Karina, Karrie, Lesley, and Thamuz's damage is True Damage, they will continue to use the "Lowest HP" targeting rule even when "Lowest Effective HP" is selected.
The original "Closest Target" and "Lowest HP Percent" options remain unchanged. Heroes using these options will not be affected.
Basic Attack Targeting Optimizations
We've optimized the targeting mechanics for Basic Attack pursuit, reducing cases where ranged heroes repeatedly switch targets between minions and enemy heroes when pursuing enemies outside their Basic Attack range.
After a Basic Attack hits a hero, tapping the Basic Attack button repeatedly within a short time will now prioritize pursuing and re-attacking that same target, unless a higher-priority enemy hero is within Basic Attack range.
Movement Control Optimizations
Added a landing indicator for all dash skills passing through obstacles.
Sanctum Island Map Updates
We've fully revamped the art assets for Sanctum Island's scene, lord, and base. The new map now offers better visuals while keeping performance nearly on par with the original. This update takes effect immediately, so please make sure all resources are downloaded before entering the game for the complete experience.
Simplified Hero Skill Descriptions
To reduce the length of hero skill descriptions and improve readability, we've replaced some commonly used attributes (Attack, Defense, and Max HP) with simple and intuitive icons.
Other

[Tab and Content Adjustments]
The "Announcements" tab will be removed. Important announcements, including patch notees, monthly events, and balance adjustments, will now be moved to the "News" tab.

[Announcement Notification Update]
Announcements will no longer use red dot badges, including those carried over to other menu icons. Announcements requiring special attention will instead be marked with a flame icon.

[Read Announcement Sorting Update]
Once read, an announcement will automatically move to the bottom of the "News" tab, making unread announcements easier to find.

[Security Announcement Display Update]
Security announcements and related content will be temporarily removed. We plan to make them available through other systems in a future patch.

10th Anniversary Revamped Hero: Wild-oats Fist - Masha
Hero Feature: A Berserker who enters the Feral state by breaking the enemy's wound.
Masha's core gameplay has been revamped. We want her to thrive as a high-skill ceiling Berserker capable of sustained combat, rather than an Assassin limited to split-pushing or burst damage.
[Passive - Primal Pact]
Masha has 3 HP bars and dies only when the last one is depleted. Masha gains Feral when dealing damage to heroes or creeps. Feral converts to HP when out of combat. Masha leaves a Wound on the enemy when dealing skill damage to them. Attacking again with a Basic Attack from the direction of the Wound will break it, putting Masha into the Feral state. While in the Feral state, her next 3 Basic Attacks become wide-range claw strikes, and she gains massive Resilience, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed.
[Skill 1 - Feral Swipe]
Masha releases energy forward, dealing Physical Damage to enemies in its path and slowing enemy heroes.
[Skill 2 - Claw Strike]

10th Anniversary Revamped Hero: The Protector - Bruno
Hero Feature: A Marksman who deals massive damage to enemies by continuously kicking powerballs.
We've made several optimizations to Bruno. While preserving his core identity, we've improved his controls and made adjustments across his kit. These changes make him a more agile and formidable striker.
[Skill 1 - Volley Shot] (~)
We believe the original Volley Shot placed too much burden on players. In the current environment, players might fail to pick up the Powerball even after planning their movement and positioning correctly. Therefore, we've optimized it.
[Controls Optimizations]
The landing distance of Powerball now scales with Bruno's Movement Speed.
The Movement Speed boost is now granted when kicking the Powerball instead of upon dealing damage.
